clue.text: Thanks a painter twice over for the mount

indicators.note: over tells us to turn the whole run of letters back to front

parts.note: TA is informal British for thanks

indicators.note: twice means the painter's letters appear two times in a row

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a painter

explanation.surface: Someone thanks an artist twice over for a mounted picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mount' looks like a picture mount but is a mountain; 'twice' doubles the painter and 'over' turns the whole run round.
explanation.definitionFit: Ararat is the Turkish mountain where Noah's ark came to rest, so it is a mount by name.

clue.text: Love creating disorder

definitions.meaning: an ailment or disease affecting part of the body

explanation.surface: Love that brings about chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both fond feeling and, in medical use, a malady affecting an organ.

clue.text: Swear before sunrise to gain access to the underworld

parts.note: to aver is to swear or declare firmly
the sun rising: in a down clue the word sun is read upwards

explanation.surface: Someone swears an oath before dawn to be let into the land of the dead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sunrise' does two things in one word: it names the sun and, in a down clue, tells you to write it going up.
explanation.definitionFit: Avernus, a crater lake near Naples, was the classical entrance to Hades and its name stands for the infernal regions.

clue.text: They'll put forward suggestions one can build on

definitions.text: They'll put forward suggestions one can build on

parts.words: They'll put forward suggestions one can build on
parts.note: build on reads like developing an idea, but here it is literal: the people whose designs get built

explanation.surface: Idea people whose proposals others can develop.
explanation.definitionFit: Designers of buildings draw up plans which builders then construct.

clue.text: Summary of a sailing man's dissertation

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a sailor; with the 's it gives ABS
a tract is a written treatise or dissertation

explanation.surface: A précis of a sailor's thesis.
explanation.definitionFit: An abstract is a short digest set at the head of a paper.

clue.text: Possibly use about a quarter inside to be fair

indicators.note: inside places the compass letter within the rearranged letters
possibly signals the letters of use and about may be arranged otherwise

parts.note: E, east, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: Perhaps use about a quarter of something in order to look good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' rearranges two clue words to BEAUTOUS, and 'inside' slips the compass letter in near the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair in its old sense of lovely; beauteous is a poetic word for good-looking.

clue.text: Gather to see a well-known friar

definitions.meaning: to fold or pleat fabric together

explanation.surface: An invitation to come and meet a famous monk.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuck is a sewn fold in cloth, and Tuck is the merry friar of the Robin Hood legends.

clue.text: A couple of animals that can present a problem

parts.note: two beasts: a nag is a horse and a ram a male sheep
two beasts: a nag is a horse and a ram a male sheep

explanation.surface: Two creatures that might cause trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: a rearrangement of letters is itself a puzzle to be solved.
explanation.definitionFit: A word puzzle made by rearranging letters poses a problem for the solver.

clue.text: Many in a queue will give tongue

indicators.note: in places the numeral within the word for queue

parts.note: a tail is a line of people, a queue
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, many

explanation.surface: Many people in a line will speak up.
explanation.definitionFit: Tongue in the sense of language; Tamil is spoken in southern India and Sri Lanka.

clue.text: A man employed in clerical duties

indicators.note: employed in says the name is at work inside the word clerical

explanation.surface: A man working in an office job.
explanation.definitionFit: A common male first name.

clue.text: A shearer making outrageous charges?

parts.note: shearing a sheep removes its coat; the slang sense is someone who strips customers of money

explanation.surface: A sheep-shearer who overcharges.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindler who takes too much money, as a shearer takes a sheep's wool.

clue.text: A large number demand 29

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number
to claim is to demand as a right

explanation.surface: Many people insist on something.
explanation.walkthrough: 29 refers to the answer at 29 across, an honour or praise.
explanation.definitionFit: Praise and approval, the same as an honour bestowed.

clue.text: Study the making-up of faces it would appear appropriate

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart

indicators.note: making-up suggests applying cosmetics but here means the letters of faces it are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Examine how faces are made up and it seems fitting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the making-up of' sounds like cosmetics but rearranges the letters; 'appropriate' looks like an adjective but is the verb, to seize.
explanation.definitionFit: To seize property officially, taking it into possession.

clue.text: Finding nothing right, almost everyone is vocal

parts.note: O, the zero figure, is nothing

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the word for everyone is dropped

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Finding nothing correct, nearly everyone speaks out.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoken rather than written, using the voice.

clue.text: Non-progressive state not against development though

indicators.note: development signals the letters of not against are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A static condition is not opposed to progress, oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: A condition of no movement or growth, like still water.

clue.text: At home, dates may be offered as an alternative

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: offered here suggests dates presented in a new form, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dates might be served at home in place of something else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be offered' rearranges DATES to STEAD.
explanation.definitionFit: In place of something else, by way of substitute.

clue.text: News agency in action is pessimistic

indicators.note: in places the word for news media inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an action
the press is the news media

explanation.surface: A news agency taking action is gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling low and without hope, gloomy in outlook.

clue.text: Turkish furniture

definitions.meaning: of the empire ruled from Constantinople
a low upholstered seat or storage box

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture from Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The empire of the Turks bore this name, and a padded footstool or chest is called one too.

clue.text: Dark clothes

parts.note: dark here is the hours of darkness, so clothing for those hours rather than sombre colours

explanation.surface: Black garments.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyjamas and nightgowns are garments worn in bed after dark.

clue.text: Relentlessly making a point concerning street-work

parts.note: N, north, is a point of the compass
on means concerning or about
OP, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Someone keeps insisting on a point about roadworks.
explanation.definitionFit: Without pause or break, continuously.

clue.text: Relatively favourable

parts.note: relatively reads as fairly, but means towards relatives: favouring one's family

explanation.surface: Moderately positive.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing favouritism to kin, especially in giving jobs.

clue.text: Endorsing the motion in a note

parts.note: a sign is a gesture or motion of the hand
G is a musical note

explanation.surface: Supporting a proposal put forward in a memo.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting one's name to a document to approve it.

clue.text: Write one's first letters

parts.note: first letters sounds like early correspondence, but means the opening letters of one's names

explanation.surface: Pen one's earliest correspondence.
explanation.definitionFit: To mark a document with the first letter of each of one's names.

clue.text: The fool is using drugs!

explanation.surface: The idiot is on drugs!
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a stupid person and for illegal narcotics.

clue.text: Play the lawyer in America without impact

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the lawyer's letters go round the word for impact

parts.note: DA is a district attorney, a US prosecutor
to ram is to strike with force

explanation.surface: Perform the role of an American attorney with no forcefulness.
explanation.definitionFit: A play is a piece for the stage, a work of theatre.

clue.text: Mistakenly trust a line from a person not involved

indicators.note: mistakenly means the letters of trust a line are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Wrongly believe a remark from a bystander.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes no side in a dispute, especially in policy between nations.

clue.text: Up-market transport

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word for market is written from the bottom

parts.note: a mart is a market

explanation.surface: Luxury travel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up-market' looks like posh, but splits into 'Up' and 'market'.
explanation.definitionFit: A streetcar running on rails is a means of transport.

clue.text: Port from the wood

definitions.meaning: a harbour town in Kent, on England's south-east coast

explanation.surface: Fortified wine served from the barrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' suggests the wine, aged in wood; it is the town.
explanation.definitionFit: Deal is a Kent harbour town and also softwood timber.

clue.text: Being without pictures it's simple

parts.note: art covers paintings and pictures
less means without, as in a suffix

explanation.surface: Having no illustrations makes it plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural and without guile, guileless and innocent.

clue.text: A moral offence at home by an egghead — so senseless

parts.note: a sin is a moral wrong
in means at home
the head, or first letter, of egg

explanation.surface: Wrongdoing at home by an intellectual is very foolish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' looks like an intellectual but gives the first letter of egg.
explanation.definitionFit: Utterly stupid, as silly as a donkey.

clue.text: It gives a man a touch of dignity

definitions.text: It gives a man a touch of dignity

parts.words: It gives a man a touch of dignity
parts.note: a touch is literal: the tap of a sword on the shoulder when a knighthood is conferred

explanation.surface: Something lends a person a little dignity.
explanation.definitionFit: The ceremonial sword-tap conferring knighthood, and by extension any honour.

clue.text: One of those beastly overheads!

parts.note: overheads suggests annoying business costs, but means things on top of an animal's head

explanation.surface: Complaining about an awful running cost.
explanation.definitionFit: A deer's branched horn grows above its head.
